name: [⚽ INTERNATIONAL] Become A Striker
desc:
⚽ Become A Striker — one chance at a time!

Start at 17 in the National League and draw your way to football glory 🏆

🎯 HOW IT PLAYS
- Play freezes at the big moments: draw a line to PASS, SHOOT or DRIBBLE
- Curl it into the top corner, thread through balls, skin defenders
- Penalties, free kicks over the wall, corners & headers

📈 YOUR CAREER
- Level up and boost Shooting, Passing, Dribbling & Pace
- 5 divisions: win promotion and get transfer offers from bigger clubs
- Earn a call-up for your country and play at the World Cup 🌍
- Chase the Golden Ball 🥇

🎁 CODES (join the group to redeem!)
⚽ GLOBALCUP – 3 Rewinds + 1 Extra Chance
⚽ PENALTYKING – 2 Extra Chances
⚽ EXTRATIME – 2 Rewinds
⚽ SAFEHANDS – 1 Rewind + 1 Extra Chance
⚽ LEGACY – 3 Rewinds
👍 Like & ⭐ favourite for more codes!

llm.loop: play key match moments in freeze-frame -> draw a line to pass, shoot or dribble -> level stats -> win promotion and transfers up 5 divisions -> World Cup call-up
llm.objectives: go from 17-year-old in National League to Golden Ball winner
llm.progression: player stats, divisions, transfers, international caps
llm.instructions: draw lines to pass/shoot/dribble at the big moments; level up stats; earn transfers and a national call-up
unique: mobile 'Score! Hero'-style draw-the-pass football career on Roblox
llm.thumbnails: striker curling shots into net in stadium lights, golden ball trophy
llm.complexity_notes: many scripted match situations, career progression
